# CommandPaletteGroup

Visual grouping with a heading label. Place inside CommandPaletteList.

## Import

```tsx
import { CommandPaletteGroup } from '@astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `heading` | `string` | - | Group heading text. **(required)** |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | CommandPaletteItem children. **(required)** |
| `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value. |
